scripts.build: pnpm build:native && pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:edge && pnpm build:firefox
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox && node scripts/smoke/check-zips.mjs --archive arthur-$npm_package_version-sources.zip
scripts.release:stores:prepare: pnpm zip:chrome:store && wxt zip -b firefox && node scripts/smoke/check-builds.mjs --store-zips && node scripts/smoke/check-zips.mjs --archive arthur-$npm_package_version-sources.zip
scripts.release:stores:dry-run: pnpm release:stores:prepare && wxt submit --dry-run --chrome-api-version v2 --chrome-publish-type DEFAULT_PUBLISH --chrome-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-chrome-store.zip --firefox-channel listed --firefox-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-firefox.zip --firefox-sources-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-sources.zip
scripts.release:stores: pnpm release:stores:prepare && wxt submit --chrome-api-version v2 --chrome-publish-type DEFAULT_PUBLISH --chrome-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-chrome-store.zip --firefox-channel listed --firefox-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-firefox.zip --firefox-sources-zip .output/arthur-$npm_package_version-sources.zip
